##### Project general facts

Afnan District by Deyaar is a large-scale residential community designed as a self-sufficient urban destination, featuring contemporary architecture and a well-planned layout centered around landscaped piazzas. Afnan District forms a key part of the development, comprising seven residential buildings with clean lines and modern façades that create a cohesive and elegant environment. The project offers a selection of thoughtfully designed apartments with functional layouts, spacious interiors, and a focus on comfort and everyday living.

Residents benefit from a wide range of amenities integrated throughout the community. The development includes landscaped open spaces, a swimming pool, basketball court, and various leisure areas, along with retail outlets and dining options within walking distance. These facilities create a vibrant and convenient lifestyle, where everything needed for daily living, relaxation, and social interaction is easily accessible.

Interiors are finished with modern materials and high-quality finishes that enhance both durability and aesthetic appeal. Kitchens are provided without appliances, offering flexibility for customization. Apartments are offered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalize their living spaces according to their preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Afnan District is a slice of paradise in the heart of Midtown that is located in the Dubai Production City (D.P.C), this residential address will attract a cosmopolitan clientele. The residents of Midtown will enjoy spectacular views of the Dubai skyline and the Jumeirah Golf Estates. 

Beyond its business focus, Dubai Production City provides a balanced lifestyle with a range of amenities. Residential complexes within the district feature contemporary designs and cater to a diverse community. With parks, retail outlets, cafes, and fitness centers, the area promotes a lifestyle of convenience and leisure. Educational institutions and healthcare facilities within close reach further enhance its appeal as a well-rounded community.

DPC also emphasizes sustainability and green living, integrating eco-friendly practices into its design. Lush landscapes and open spaces are thoughtfully incorporated, providing a refreshing environment for residents and visitors. Whether you’re a business professional seeking a dynamic workspace or a family looking for a vibrant neighborhood, Dubai Production City offers a unique blend of innovation, comfort, and connectivity.
